pages.title: Taking a taxi or rideshare

unit.name: Getting around
map: Renting a bike or a car

situation.text: It is late afternoon and you need to get across town. You get in a taxi, tell the driver where to go, ask about the trip and get out at the right place.

pages.goal: By the end of the class you can tell a driver where to go, ask how long the trip will take, ask to stop and pay politely.
canDo: Say where to go: Could you take me to…?
Ask: How long will it take?
Ask the driver to stop: Stop here, please.
Pay and thank the driver: Keep the change.
success: I say where I want to go.
I ask to stop at the right place.
I pay and thank the driver.
pages.think: When you take a taxi or a rideshare, what do you say first? What can go wrong?

teach.goal: Abrir a aula pela situação real, não pela regra.
solo: Leia o objetivo em voz alta e peça que o estudante diga com as próprias palavras o que vai fazer hoje.
Pergunte “Think about it” antes de mostrar qualquer expressão.
group: Cada estudante diz UMA palavra que associa à situação de hoje.
Mostre os 4 critérios de sucesso: é a missão final da aula.
extra: How do you usually get around at night?
Have you ever taken a taxi in another country?
support: Aceite respostas curtas ou em português na primeira rodada e reformule em inglês.

pages.title: Connection & warm-up

intro.solo: Start with real questions about the student’s life, not a grammar test.
intro.group: One question per student, then a question back to a classmate.

pages.recall: Quick recall from the last class: “I’d like to check in”, “Where is gate…?”. Ask: Where is the gate? What do you say to start a check-in?

qs.q: Do you use taxis or rideshare apps?
qs.pt: Você usa táxi ou aplicativo de transporte?

qs.q: Is it easy to get a ride in your city?
qs.pt: É fácil conseguir uma corrida na sua cidade?

qs.q: Do you talk to drivers or stay quiet?
qs.pt: Você conversa com motoristas ou fica quieto?

pages.tip: Use the answers to find gaps and to recycle earlier content. The goal is to enter English from the first minute.

teach.goal: Entrar no idioma no primeiro minuto, retomar a aula anterior e mapear lacunas.
extra: What do you talk about with a driver?
When do you tip? How much?

errors.w: I go to work by foot.

support: Ofereça as respostas-modelo (chips) e peça apenas que escolham uma.

pages.title: Cultural snapshot — Life in the USA
pages.intro: Getting a ride in the USA can be a taxi on the street or a car you call with an app. Look at the cards and guess.

cards.note: You choose a destination in the app and the app shows the car and the driver.

cards.pt: Confira o carro e o nome
cards.note: Before you get in, check the license plate and the driver’s name in the app.
A tip is customary in the U.S., for example about 15–20% for a taxi.

qs.q: How do people call a ride?
qs.pt: Como as pessoas chamam uma corrida?

levels.A1: With an app. Or a taxi.
levels.A2: They use an app or hail a taxi on the street.
levels.B1: Many people order a car with an app, and others hail a taxi or go to a taxi stand.
levels.B2: Apps are everywhere, but street hailing and taxi stands still work in many busy areas.

qs.q: What should you check before you get in?
qs.pt: O que você deve conferir antes de entrar?

levels.A2: The driver’s name and the license plate.
levels.B1: You check the plate number and the driver’s name to be sure it is your car.
levels.B2: Matching the plate and driver to the app protects you from getting into the wrong car.

qs.q: Do people tip drivers in the USA?
qs.pt: Nos EUA as pessoas dão gorjeta aos motoristas?

levels.B1: Yes, tipping is customary: about 15–20% for taxis, and apps let you add a tip.
levels.B2: Tipping is an expected custom for service work, though the exact amount varies and is a personal choice.

pages.compare: In Brazil many people use apps and also tip a little, but tipping is not as expected as in the USA. How do people thank a driver where you live?

teach.goal: Ativar o contexto cultural e as primeiras hipóteses.
solo: Mostre os 3 cartões e peça hipóteses antes de explicar.
Peça que o estudante compare com a sua própria experiência no Brasil.
group: Cada estudante escolhe um cartão e explica em uma frase.
Pergunte “Do you agree?” entre colegas.
answers: Q1: aplicativo ou táxi na rua.
Q2: nome do motorista e placa.
Q3: sim, gorjeta é comum (cerca de 15–20% no táxi).
extra: What do you check before you get in?
support: Use as respostas do nível A1 como andaime e peça que repitam.
stretch: B2: compare as convenções do Brasil e dos EUA nesta situação.

pass1.pt: O que a mulher está fazendo?

teach.goal: Compreender a situação antes de ver o texto: ideia principal e depois as informações-chave.
solo: Esconda o texto. 1ª escuta: só a ideia principal.
2ª escuta: as informações da tarefa 2.
Mostre o texto só depois da 2ª escuta.
group: Escuta coletiva; duplas anotam as respostas antes de revelar.
Compare as respostas entre as duplas e só então mostre o texto.
answers: Pass 2: Pine Street · fifteen minutes · seat belt · on the right · keep the change.
extra: Who is speaking? How do you know?
Which word did you catch first?
support: Pause depois de cada fala se necessário.

qs.q: Where does she want to go?
What does the driver ask for?
What does she say at the end?

retell.prompt: Retell the conversation in your own words, at your level.
starters: A woman takes a taxi to…

teach.goal: Ler o diálogo, perceber os chunks e recontar.
solo: O estudante lê um papel e você lê o outro; depois trocam.
Peça que reconte a conversa no nível que conseguir.
group: Leitura em duplas e troca de papéis.
Reconto em cadeia: uma frase por estudante.
answers: The art museum · seat belt · fifteen minutes · Keep the change
extra: What would YOU say to the driver?

errors.w: You take me to the airport?
errors.r: Could you take me to the airport?

support: Mostre a tradução (botão PT) depois da 2ª leitura.

pages.title: Useful expressions

items.use: Tell the driver where you want to go.
Ask about the length of the trip.
The driver asks you to buckle up.
Ask the price of the ride.
Tip the driver with the extra money.
The driver says you have arrived.

items.en: Could you take me to the airport?

pages.note: Instead of memorizing the whole list, choose 3–5 expressions (★) to use again and again. The others are for understanding and for stretching later.

teach.goal: Escolher 3–5 chunks para uso repetido e descobrir a função de cada um.
solo: Pergunte “When do you say it?” antes de dar o significado.
Peça um exemplo próprio para cada expressão ★.
group: Cada estudante escolhe a expressão que mais usaria e explica quando.
Compare equivalentes formais e informais em duplas.
answers: Prioritárias: Could you take me to…? · How long will it take? · Stop here, please. · Keep the change.
extra: Which of these would you say to a friend? To a stranger?
support: Trabalhe só as expressões ★ nesta aula.

patterns.name: Polite request
ex: Could you take me to the airport?
Could you turn on the air conditioning?

patterns.name: Asking about time
patterns.formula: **How long will it take?** / **How long is** + noun?
ex: How long does it take to get there?

head: Spoken English
Written English
rows: Could you take me to Pine Street?
I would like to be taken to Pine Street.
What is the estimated travel time?
Please keep the remaining amount as a tip.
register.note: These are differences of context and register, not absolute rules: apps and receipts use the written forms.

teach.goal: Fixar os padrões principais; os outros são expansão. Usar a troca de palavras para variar a fala.
solo: Mostre o padrão DENTRO do diálogo (grife os chunks).
Use “Swap the words”: toque em cada peça e peça que o estudante diga a frase completa.
Compare spoken × written em 2 exemplos.
group: Troca em cadeia: cada estudante muda UMA peça e o próximo repete a frase.
Em pares: um escolhe as peças, o outro fala.
teach.answers: Os padrões principais (main) são o foco; os demais são expansão para quem avançar rápido.
extra: Change one word and say the new sentence.

errors.w: I go to the museum by taxi to.
errors.r: I’m going to the museum by taxi.

support: Fique só com o primeiro padrão na primeira rodada.
stretch: Combinar dois padrões na mesma fala.

pages.title: Pronunciation lab — natural American English
pages.tip: In fast speech “could you” sounds like “couldja” and “take me to” like “take me tuh”. Small words get short and weak.

items.say: Could you take me to the airport?
items.linked: Couldja TAKE me tuh the AIR·port?

own.prompt: Write your own “Could you…?” request for a driver. Say “could you” as “couldja”.
own.criteria: Say it twice: first slowly, then reduced. Did “could you” sound like “couldja”?

teach.goal: UM só fenômeno: Reductions in fast speech.
solo: 3 passagens: escutar e identificar → reproduzir ritmo e entonação → usar em frase com conteúdo próprio.
Modele devagar e normal; peça que o estudante bata palmas na sílaba forte.
group: Coro, depois duplas; circule ouvindo.
Cada estudante cria uma frase própria.
answers: Identify 1: Could you take me? · Identify 2: How long will it take?
support: Reduza a velocidade e conte as batidas em voz alta.

levels.h: Controlled practice — choose the best answer

items.q: 1. You get in a taxi. The driver asks: “Where to?”
opts: Could you take me to the station?
items.why: Could you take me to…? is polite and clear.

items.q: 2. You want to know the length of the trip.
items.why: How long will it take? asks about time.
Stop here, please. is short and polite.

items.q: 4. The ride is $18. You pay $20 and you are happy.
items.why: Keep the change = you leave the extra money as a tip.

levels.h: Guided practice — complete, substitute and transform

items.text: ___ you take me to the airport?

items.instr: Make it more polite with “Could you”:
ans: Could you take me to the hotel?
Could you take me to the hotel, please?
Could you take me to the hotel please?
items.model: Could you take me to the hotel, please?
items.why: Could you… sounds softer than a command.
How much is…? asks about price.

opts: Here you go. Keep the change!

teach.goal: Do controlado ao guiado: completar, substituir e transformar antes da fala livre.
solo: Peça que o estudante justifique cada resposta.
Se acertar rápido, peça a versão mais informal ou mais educada.
group: Resolvam em duplas e comparem antes de revelar.
Equipes: ponto por resposta justificada.
answers: 1: Could you take me to the station? · 2: How long will it take? · 3: Stop here, please. · 4: Keep the change.
Gap: Could · long · Could you take me to the hotel, please? · How much is the ride? · Here you go. Keep the change!
extra: Say each correct answer aloud with the right reduction.
support: Ofereça o banco de palavras (chips) nas lacunas.

pages.title: Personalized roleplay — take a ride across the city

brief.teacher: You are the driver (add a change: there is a lot of traffic!).
brief.student: You are the passenger: say where to go, ask about the trip and pay.

orders: To a friend’s house on Oak Street
complications: There is heavy traffic: the trip will be longer.
You want to stop before your destination.
The price is higher than you expected.
You are in a hurry: ask the driver to go faster politely.
success: I say where I want to go.
I ask to stop at the right place.
I pay and thank the driver.

teach.goal: Simulação com complicação inesperada e três rodadas com menos apoio.
solo: Combine o cenário com a vida do estudante (um lugar que ele realmente frequenta).
Rodada 1: com chunks. Rodada 2: só palavras-chave. Rodada 3: sem roteiro.
Meta de fala: 60–70% do tempo para o estudante. Anote 2–3 correções para a devolutiva.
extra: What if the driver goes the wrong way? What do you say?

errors.w: You take me to the airport?
errors.r: Could you take me to the airport?

support: Volte à rodada 1 se travar; peça que repita só a primeira frase.
stretch: Peça que o estudante peça para o motorista esperar por 5 minutos e ele pagar depois.

rounds.title: Say where to go
rounds.task: Say your destination. Your partner is the driver.

rounds.title: Ask about the trip
rounds.hint: How long will it take? / How much is it?

rounds.title: Solve a problem
rounds.task: There is traffic or you need to stop early.

rounds.title: Share stories
rounds.task: Whole group: each pair tells their best ride.
rounds.hint: We took a taxi to… and…

infogap.title: Ride fares
infogap.instr: Ask your partner and complete your card. Do not look at the other card!

a.title: Passenger asks
a.task: You know the airport and the stadium. Ask about the rest.

b.title: Driver answers
b.task: You know the museum and the beach. Ask about the rest.

teach.goal: Fluência por repetição da função com informações novas a cada rodada.
group: Troque os pares a cada rodada (A+B / C+D → A+C / B+D → A+D / B+C → grupo todo). Com 6 estudantes, três duplas simultâneas.
Sem salas simultâneas: interações sequenciais enquanto uma dupla apresenta.
Responsabilidade individual: cada aluno faz ≥1 pergunta e ≥1 resposta.
answers: Info gap: A tem Airport ($35, 30 min) e Stadium ($22, 20 min); B tem Museum ($12, 10 min) e Beach ($40, 45 min).
extra: How much is it to the beach?
How long does it take to the museum?

errors.w: It costs 40 dollars to the beach.

support: Entregue frases-modelo no chat da turma.

pages.title: Group mission — a ride across town
pages.goal: Each group takes a ride in English: say where to go, ask about the trip, stop at the right place and pay.

missions.mission: Take a ride to the airport. Ask how long it will take and the price.
missions.constraint: Use “Could you take me to…?” and “How long…?”
missions.start: Hi! Could you take me to…

missions.mission: There is a lot of traffic. Ask the driver to stop at a corner near your hotel.
Pay the driver and leave a tip. Check that your bag is with you.

teach.goal: Realizar algo com o inglês: o objetivo é resolver, não só falar certo.
group: Cada grupo recebe papel, restrição e missão. Alterne os papéis.
Progressão: 1ª rodada com frases de apoio, 2ª só palavras-chave, 3ª sem roteiro.
Observe e anote 2–3 correções prioritárias; devolutiva no fim.
answers: Modelo: “Could you take me to the airport?” → “Sure.” → “How long will it take?” → “About 30 minutes.” → “Stop here, please.”
extra: What if the other person does not understand you?
support: Dê o início de frase (“Start with”) em cada cartão.

pages.title: Writing — a small real-life task
pages.task: Write a short message to a friend: tell them you are in a taxi, where you are going and when you will arrive.
pages.model: Hi Maya! I’m in a taxi to the museum. **It takes about fifteen minutes.** See you at the entrance!
checklist: I said where I am going.
I said how long it takes.
I closed in a friendly way.
pages.tip: Fix only 2–3 priority points. Show a more natural way to say the same idea instead of rewriting everything.

teach.goal: Produção escrita curta ligada à situação comunicativa.
solo: Peça o texto; corrija 2–3 pontos prioritários e mostre uma forma mais natural.
group: Cada estudante escreve; depois troquem os textos entre colegas e corrijam em duplas.
extra: Add one more detail to your message.
support: Dê o modelo e peça só para trocar os dados.

criteria.name: Fluency
criteria.desc: Mantém a comunicação sem interrupções excessivas.

criteria.name: Language use
criteria.desc: Utiliza adequadamente padrões, vocabulário e expressões.

criteria.name: Pronunciation
criteria.desc: É compreensível e usa ritmo e entonação adequados.

criteria.name: Interaction
criteria.desc: Responde, pergunta, esclarece e desenvolve a conversa.

interpret.text: Needs more support. Revisit the main patterns with guided practice before the next lesson.
Functional performance. Work on the lowest criteria in the next lesson.
Good control. Raise complexity and speed; add follow-up questions.
Strong performance. Move to a more demanding situation.

prompts.well: Example: You said your destination politely and asked how long it would take.
prompts.improve: Example: Reduce “could you” to “couldja” in fast speech.
prompts.next: Example: Deal with traffic and a change of destination without notes.

teach.goal: Avaliar o que o aluno conseguiu comunicar, não só os erros gramaticais.
solo: O estudante se autoavalia primeiro; depois você.
Feche com os três blocos: What you did well · What to improve · Your next challenge.
group: Dê um comentário por critério a cada estudante.
Cada um escolhe o próprio próximo desafio.
teach.answers: A rubrica é uma ferramenta interna de acompanhamento, não uma certificação CEFR.

tasks.name: Build a question
tasks.prompt: Without notes: ask how long the trip will take.

tasks.name: Respond to a situation
tasks.prompt: You arrive at your destination. What do you say to the driver?

tasks.name: Use a new expression
tasks.prompt: Ask the driver to take you to the airport.
tasks.model: Could you take me to the airport?

items: Record a 45–60 second audio: take a taxi to a place you know.
Write a short message telling a friend you are on your way by taxi.
Review three expressions from the class and create your own examples.
Listen to the dialogue again and mark the reduced words.

unit: Travel · ask · check in · find your way

teach.goal: Toda aula termina com uma produção observável.
solo: Sem consultar as anotações: construir uma pergunta, responder a uma situação e usar uma expressão nova.
group: Exit challenge individual; compare com o colega e combine a tarefa de continuidade.
teach.answers: How long will it take? · Stop here, please. · Could you take me to the airport?
extra: Revisão espaçada: retomar na próxima aula, depois de uma semana e na missão de encerramento da unidade.

pages.title: Level up — the same situation from A1 to C2
pages.intro: You do not need six different methods: the structure stays, while language complexity and autonomy grow.

ladder.goal: Say where to go with short phrases and pictures.

ladder.say: Could you take me to the airport? How long will it take?
Could you take the highway? I’m in a bit of a hurry.
ladder.goal: Make a request and explain a reason.

ladder.say: I’d appreciate it if you could avoid downtown, since there’s a parade today.
If it’s all the same to you, I’d rather take the longer route than sit in that traffic.
I’d be obliged if we could skirt the center altogether; time matters less to me than not sitting through the gridlock.

pages.note: This progression is illustrative: complex sentences do not define a level on their own. CEFR also considers comprehension, autonomy, fluency, accuracy, interaction and appropriateness.

teach.goal: Mostrar a progressão sem criar seis metodologias.
solo: Mostre onde o estudante está e a próxima etapa.
group: Cada um escolhe a frase do próprio nível e a do próximo.
